added.summary: --map-* roles for the world map's marker pins per kind, name plates, chosen and focus rings and legend marks, the place card's fill, picture fade, rule and buttons, the minimap's bezel, glass, grid, north badge, cone and kind colours with pip sizes from the type scale, and the run map's rooms (fill, rim, open, current, done check) and paths (taken, ahead, width), which a style pack sets to restyle maps.

breaking.change: RpgWorldMap draws no panel: the map art is the screen. Each kind of marker is its own pin shape with its icon, names sit white on cut plates, the chosen marker is ringed, danger is marked red on its triangle while its name stays white, and the legend draws the markers' own marks (stacked in a corner on a narrow screen). The parts RpgWorldMap.cell and RpgWorldMap.dot are gone.
breaking.fix: A style that dressed RpgWorldMap.cell or .dot dresses RpgWorldMap.marker; the name is RpgWorldMap.plate. Set the --map-marker-*, --map-name-* and --map-legend-* tokens for the map's look.

breaking.change: RpgPlaceCard is a bare card: the picture fading into it, the name scrolling when long (text-overflow: -og-scroll), a gold rule, the about line, and Mark and Travel buttons. The part RpgPlaceCard.headline is gone.
breaking.fix: A style that dressed RpgPlaceCard.headline dresses RpgPlaceCard.name. Set the --map-card-*, --map-picture-*, --map-go-* and --map-ghost-* tokens for the card's look.

breaking.change: MinimapView is a bezel round smoked glass with a north badge on its rim and a zone plate; markers keep a shape per kind (objective diamond, ally and enemy discs, loot square) sized from the type scale, so they stay told apart at any text size. The parts MinimapView.plate, .cell, .frame, .dot, .gridline and .tag are gone.
breaking.fix: A style that dressed MinimapView.frame dresses .bezel, .plate dresses .glass, .gridline dresses .grid, .dot or .cell dresses .marker and .tag dresses .badge. Set the --map-bezel-*, --map-glass-* and --map-pip-* tokens for its look.

breaking.change: CardRunMap draws no board over the act's art: a room is a disc, or a diamond for an elite or the boss, its kind in its icon; the path taken is solid gold over the faint paths ahead; the legend draws each kind's mark as its rooms do, from a legend row's new shape. The parts CardRunMap.label, .plate, .well and .figure are gone; the rooms are NodeGraph's, restyled through its tokens.
breaking.fix: A style that dressed CardRunMap.well, .plate or .figure sets the --map-room-* and --map-path-* tokens; .label dresses CardRunMap.row. Give each legend row the shape its rooms take.
